slides.title: Converting Words to Numbers 🔤
slides.content:
# From Strings to Vectors

Computers cannot compute derivatives on raw strings. Text must undergo a two-step conversion:

```
Raw Text:       "Artificial Intelligence is amazing"
                       |
                       v  [Tokenization: BPE / WordPiece]
Tokens:         ["Art", "ificial", "Intelligence", "is", "amazing"]
Token IDs:      [2410,   8912,      14920,          318,  7231]
                       |
                       v  [Embedding Lookup]
Dense Vectors:  [[0.12, -0.45, ...], [0.88, 0.14, ...], ...]
```

### Word Embeddings (Word2Vec, GloVe):
Embeddings map semantic meaning into geometric distance. Famous geometric relationship:
$$
\vec{King} - \vec{Man} + \vec{Woman} \approx \vec{Queen}
$$
Words with similar meanings cluster together in continuous vector space.

quizData.question: What mathematical metric is most commonly used to quantify the semantic similarity between two normalized embedding vectors?
quizData.explanation: Cosine similarity measures the cosine of the angle between two multi-dimensional vectors, evaluating directional alignment regardless of magnitude.
